name: Original tutorial crate Poison of Illness: genuine acquisition baseline

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ImperialDungeon01
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data-local="{output}/test-data"
content=tutorial-passage-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 1280
resolution y = 720
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = false

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.5

local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local Actor=types.Actor
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local elapsed=-1
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 elapsed=elapsed+dt;if elapsed<.2 then return end;elapsed=0
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died at original crate poison')
 local stock=Actor.inventory(self):countOf(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x8dc73))
 print('TutorialPoison stock='..stock..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current)
 for _,o in pairs(Actor.getEquipment(self)) do if o.recordId==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x90613) then print('TutorialPoison Rusty Axe equipped') end end
 if stock>0 then return end
 local o=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x159854));assert(o and o:isValid(),'Original crate poison missing')
 local box=o:getBoundingBox();local origin=camera.getPosition();local aim=nil
 for _,x in ipairs({{0,-.6,.6}}) do for _,y in ipairs({{0,-.6,.6}}) do for _,z in ipairs({{0,-.6,.6}}) do
 local p=box.center+util.vector3(x*math.max(16,box.halfSize.x),y*math.max(16,box.halfSize.y),z*math.max(16,box.halfSize.z))
 local hit=nearby.castRenderingRay(origin,p,{{ignore=self}})
 if hit.hitObject==o then aim=hit.hitPos;break end
 end;if aim then break end end;if aim then break end end
 local p=camera.getViewTransform():apply(aim or box.center)
 local ax=math.atan2(p.x,-p.z);local ay=-math.atan2(p.y,math.sqrt(p.x*p.x+p.z*p.z))
 local function units(v) return math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(v*256+.5))) end
 print(string.format('TutorialPoison aim x=%d y=%d',units(ax),units(ay)))
 local v=camera.viewportToWorldVector(util.vector2(.5,.5));local hit=nearby.castRenderingRay(origin,origin+v*2000,{{ignore=self}})
 if hit.hitObject==o and (hit.hitPos-origin):length()<140 then print('TutorialPoison focused') end
end}}}}
